instruction: Software available for this task: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. For this task, open Revit 2025, Archicad 27, or Abaqus CAE from the corresponding desktop shortcut, according to the tool you choose for the task. Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool from these three to complete the task. Seed create clinic pair. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the selected application before editing. The seed file is only a simple editable starting reference; keep useful existing geometry, but it is acceptable to redraw simple walls, floors, rooms, doors, windows, roofs, stairs, columns, or beams with native tools in the selected application if that is faster. Create a one-storey clinic pair with rooms named Waiting and Exam. Add one partition, one slab, two doors, and two windows. This task focuses on a small healthcare room pair. Create real BIM model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the selected application's Room/Zone/Space tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the completed model deliverable into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result` using the selected application's built-in export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Waiting, Exam; at least 1 building storeys, at least 5 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 2 doors, at least 2 windows. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
